title: Release v1.0.0 · smokeeaasd/flawless-ui-ux

content_html:
Interactive installation and twelve-agent support

Run npx flawless-ui-ux@latest install, pnpm dlx flawless-ui-ux@latest install, or bunx flawless-ui-ux@latest install from your project. The terminal wizard lets you choose project/global scope, select agents, review destinations, and confirm before copying.

What's new since 0.3.0

  • Support for Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity, Kiro, Cursor, Kilo Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, Claude Code, Pi, Grok Build, Devin CLI, and DeepSeek Harness.
  • Interactive installation with cancellation, plus direct flags, combined individual agent selectors, and --yes. JSON, CI, and non-terminal execution stay noninteractive.
  • Shared destinations copied once: twelve logical agents use five project-local copies of the same skill. Existing files, local edits, and links remain protected; all selected paths are preflighted and newly allocated copies are rolled back after failure.
  • Host-specific global configuration roots, including Grok Build, DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, Pi, and platform-specific Devin paths.
  • Updated README with a full-width SVG banner, agent icons, installation examples, and linked badges.

Requirements and scope

  • Node 22.12+; Bun remains the development toolchain.
  • Rendered inspection requires a separately prepared compatible Chromium and a running app URL.
  • Context, inspect, and verify retain their existing behavior. The portable design guidance is unchanged by this release.
  • Automated/runtime tests and recorded host inventories do not establish full WCAG conformance or matched model design-quality/latency outcomes. macOS terminal behavior remains unverified.
